versions.localizedDescription:
Turn your iPhone into a Dumb Phone.

Dumb Phone™ lets you create your very own minimalist-style phone on iOS.

Replace colorful app icons, pesky notification badges, and anything that might give you a dopamine hit when you unlock your phone, with simple buttons to open your essential apps - and nothing more.

Key features:

• Break out of your existing habits
Every time you unlock your phone, all you will see is apps that you need, without being coerced into easy distractions from colorful apps on your Home Screen or the App Library.

• Create a Minimalist Launcher
Select apps and add Dumb Phone widgets to your Home Screen to blend everything together.
